tagline: 佳能胶片相机，1999 年发布
description: The Canon Autoboy Luna XL is a compact, automatic 35mm film camera introduced in 1999, with a zoom lens and autofocus, and a dial for selecting shooting modes.[http://global.canon/en/c-museum/product/film208.html Autoboy Luna XL on Canon Camera Museum] It was released in Japan only.
